v0.1.0 · Apache-2.0 · Python 3.12+

A reproducible benchmark for hybrid search engines.

A reproducible benchmark for hybrid search engines — BM25 + dense vector + cross-encoder rerank — on distractor-augmented BEIR scifact. For retrieval engineers comparing fusion strategies, ML researchers validating new encoders, and OSS maintainers who publish numbers they can defend.

Get started View on GitHub →
  • Five modes: BM25, dense vector, hybrid RRF, hybrid rerank, DiskBBQ.
  • Six embedders: MiniLM-L6, BGE-small/base/large, mpnet-base, E5-Mistral-7B.
  • Four rerankers: MiniLM-L6 cross-encoder, BGE-large, BGE-base, MonoT5-3B.
  • One BM25 pre-flight: 0.6789 ± 0.03 vs Anserini; fails fast if it breaks.
Headline 5K scifact, BM25 + MiniLM-L6 + ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6
ModenDCG@10R@10p95 ms
bm250.65690.77840.9
vector (flat)0.64510.78330.1
hybrid_rrf0.70160.84821.1
hybrid_rerank0.68200.8062167.3

Reproduce with trivium-benchmark --modes bm25,vector,hybrid_rrf,hybrid_rerank --scales 5000.

Why hybrid search, why trivium

Reproducible

Every CSV row carries Python, OS, numpy, faiss, sentence-transformers, torch, bm25s, faiss OMP thread count, and git SHA. The BM25 pre-flight equivalence check pins the BM25 implementation to the published Anserini baseline.

Honest about limits

The README and CHANGELOG both spell out what the benchmark does NOT measure: E5-Mistral-7B / BGE-large / MonoT5-3B ceilings, RAM-resident vector index, bm25s-vs-Lucene drift. No hand-waved numbers.

Extensible

Adding a new encoder, reranker, or pipeline mode is one decorator call. The registry-driven runner has no elif chains; the pre-flight golden test catches regressions in any pipeline.

Install and run in five commands

  1. Install the package

    pip install trivium

  2. Prepare the corpus and embeddings

    trivium-prepare --max-scales 100000

  3. Run the benchmark

    trivium-benchmark \
  --modes bm25,vector,hybrid_rrf,hybrid_rerank \
  --scales 5000,100000 \
  --output results/benchmark.csv

  4. Summarise the headline rows

    trivium-summarise --csv results/benchmark.csv

  5. Read the docs

    Continue with Getting started, Architecture, or Methodology.
